missed.why: A 16-bit buffer in one TSSOP-48 part, so 1 part carries all 16 PWM lines where the rank-1 244A needs 2. Datasheet SCAS699C (revised June 2014, read 2026-09-28T13:30:24Z, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74lvc16244a.pdf): Ioff ±10 µA at VCC 0 with VI or VO = 5.5 V, VOH 2.2 V at IOH −24 mA with VCC 3 V, tdis 6.2 ns max at 3.3 V, TA −40 to 125 °C. The 4 OE pins (1, 24, 25, 48) are active low, so it needs the enable inverter. TI product page: ACTIVE (https://www.ti.com/product/SN74LVC16244A, 13:35:08Z). JLCPCB C7822: stockCount 2841, canPresaleNumber 2833, extended, USD 1.6857 at qty 1 (13:33:29Z). Gate at 1 per board is 50. Digi-Key SN74LVC16244ADGGR: 15401, Active, lead 16 weeks (13:35:35Z). Pin-compatible alternate from a second maker: see 74LVC16244ADGG,118

A pin-for-pin alternate of SN74CBTLV3126PWR. The page-2 pin assignment (1OE 1, A1 2, B1 3, 2OE 4, A2 5, B2 6, GND 7, B3 8, A3 9, 3OE 10, B4 11, A4 12, 4OE 13, VCC 14) matches the SCDS038N pin table, and OE is active high. Datasheet Rev. 7.0.A, dated 2026-04-21 (read 13:32:35Z, https://toshiba.semicon-storage.com/info/docget.jsp?did=12250&prodName=TC7MBL3126CFT). IOFF is 10 µA (−40 to 85 °C) at VCC 0 with OE, A, B = 0 to 3.6 V. That states OE explicitly, where SCDS038N writes only 'VI or VO'. Switch I/O is 0 to 3.6 V recommended with VCC 0 or the switch off, but 0 to VCC with the switch on (absolute maximum VCC + 0.5 V). That is the same condition P2 used to drop Nexperia's 74CBTLV3126DS against a 3.6 V line while enabled. RON is 11 Ω max at VIS 0 V and 17 Ω at 3.0 V (VCC 3.0 V, 30 mA). VIH on OE is 0.7 × VCC. Topr −40 to 125 °C. JLCPCB C2675020: stockCount 50, canPresaleNumber 50, USD 0.8266 (13:33:20Z). That passes the gate of 50 only at 2 per board; at the 6 per board of gated-buffer rank 3 it fails. Digi-Key: 3493, Active, lead 16 weeks (13:32:28Z). The SN74CBTLV3126PWR's own Digi-Key route passes too: 3756, Active (13:35:52Z)

The auto-direction family: both directions with one OE and no direction pin. Both fail and should be recorded as drops. TXB0104 (SCES650K, revised March 2025, read 13:38:19Z) recommends no external pull resistors and, if one is needed, more than 50 kΩ; that conflicts with the 10 kΩ pull-down and the 1 kΩ pull-up. Its OE current II is stated only at VCCA 1.2 to 3.6 V. TXS0104E (SCES651K, revised October 2023, read 13:38:20Z) has an internal 10 kΩ pull-up on each A and B I/O. Against the 10 kΩ pull-down, its own equation (1) gives an idle of VCC × 10 k / 20 k, 1.65 V, not low

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: switch voltage recommended at 0 to VCC with an absolute maximum of VCC + 0.5 V, below the 3.6 V device level
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: Only the absolute-maximum clause fails. With the 3.3 V rail at ±3 %, VCC + 0.5 V is 3.70 to 3.90 V, which is above 3.6 V, not below it. The clause is below 3.6 V only with VCC at 0 V (0.5 V), although the same Rev. 7 datasheet states IOFF ±10 µA with VI or VO = 0 V to 3.6 V (read 2026-09-28T13:34:32Z). Both drops still stand on other grounds. DS stands on the recommended VSW of 0 to VCC in enable and disable mode. PW stands on rule 4: JLCPCB C478017 has 0 (13:37:01Z). The re-rank should apply the same switch-on 0-to-VCC test to Toshiba TC7MBL3126CFT, whose datasheet states it. SN74CBTLV3126 states no recommended range for the switch I/O, only an absolute maximum VI of 4.6 V (SCDS038N)
